Naming (`requestedPage` vs `page`) is self-explaining, no magic values, nothing dead. It loses a point for `new PageImpl<>(List.of(george(), new Owner()))`: a bare production constructor and an unnamed irrelevant owner, against the factory and data-naming rules. Docs move fully — REQ-OWN-005 anchor, prose, done-when clause, and the OwnerController traceability row.
